summary: [CRITICAL] Document 'pol-ac-001' language changed (6 risked obligation deltas). Frameworks possibly affected: CIS Controls, FedRAMP KSI, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53. Assessments possibly affected: SOC 2 Type II 2026, ISO 27001 Surveillance 2026, Enterprise Customer Trust Questionnaire Pack.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Security operations shall review privileged access anomalies weekly.
verbiage_changes.after_text: Security operations shall review privileged access anomalies daily.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Control language was rewritten. Re-validate mapped controls and evidence.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Older runbooks may still mention ISO 27001:2013 and NIST CSF 1.1.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Control language was removed. Evidence for mapped controls may fail.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Orphaned accounts shall be disabled within 24 hours of detection.
verbiage_changes.after_text: Orphaned accounts shall be disabled within 4 hours of detection.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Response window tightened from within 24 hours to within 4 hours.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Account reviews must occur at least quarterly.
verbiage_changes.after_text: Account reviews must occur at least monthly.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Control language was rewritten. Re-validate mapped controls and evidence.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Owners must update those references during the next revision cycle.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Control language was removed. Evidence for mapped controls may fail.

verbiage_changes.before_text: Temporary elevated access should expire within 24 hours.
verbiage_changes.after_text: Temporary elevated access should expire within 8 hours.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: Response window tightened from within 24 hours to within 8 hours.

verbiage_changes.after_text: All external framework citations must reference ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: New obligation added. Confirm owners and evidence still align.

verbiage_changes.after_text: Joiner-mover-leaver workflows must update access within one business day of an HR status change.
verbiage_changes.risk_note: New obligation added. Confirm owners and evidence still align.
